dataset._comment: If csv_path does not exist, ml/dataset.py falls back to a synthetic stand-in so the pipeline still runs end-to-end.

pca._comment: Algorithm 2: keeps the smallest Fm such that >= (1 - variance_tolerance) of variance is retained.

edge_node._comment_mode: 'hardware' = real ESP32 running esp32/esp32_tinyml_ids.ino; 'software' = scripts/simulate_edge_node.py runs the same model on your PC and posts alerts the same way the ESP32 would. Both modes talk to the SAME controller REST API below.

controller._comment_alert_url: Used by BOTH esp32_tinyml_ids.ino (edit the matching constant there, since the ESP32 cannot read this JSON file) and simulate_edge_node.py (reads this file directly).
